response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratio, AVG(line_item_count) AS avg_line_item_count FROM (SELECT order_item_id, AVG(derived_product_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY order_item_id) AS t

assumptions.assumption: Ratios with a zero derived_total_cost are treated as missing (NULLIF) to avoid division errors, along with NULL values; the multiplication by 1.0 forces decimal division.
The count of invoice line items per order item counts all rows for that order_item_id, including those whose ratio is missing.
